## Surface & ice

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [SlabSurface](SlabSurface.qmd#climt.SlabSurface) | Calculate the surface energy balance. |
| [IceSheet](IceSheet.qmd#climt.IceSheet) | 1-d snow-ice energy balance model (deprecated shim over SeaIce/LandIce). |
| [SeaIce](SeaIce.qmd#climt.SeaIce) | 1-D thermodynamic sea-ice model over sea-ice cells. |
| [LandIce](LandIce.qmd#climt.LandIce) | 1-D thermodynamic snow/ice model over land and land-ice cells. |
| [BucketHydrology](BucketHydrology.qmd#climt.BucketHydrology) | Manages surface energy and moisture balance |
| [SecondBEST](SecondBEST.qmd#climt.SecondBEST) | Modular intermediate-complexity BEST land surface model. |
